## Idea and baseline

Describe the change and whether it is systems-only, an architecture change, or a new training objective.

## Reproduction

Provide the source commit, exact commands/configs, data and validation hashes, model/data seeds, Python/Torch versions and named hardware.

## Quality and timing

Include the primary next-byte validation target, evaluation interval, all run loss curves, target failures, synchronized training time and end-to-end time. Include memory measurements when available.

## Evidence

Attach or link receipts for both baseline and candidate. Report the seed count and variability. Distinguish isolated kernel measurements from full-model time-to-quality.

## Limitations

State anything unmeasured, incomplete or changed in the protocol.
